messages:
ellen_csm: FYI Sprout Accelerator is running a partner demo on Tue and asked for a region pin + small QPS bump in ap-southeast-1 for 90 minutes. They also need two IPs allowlisted. This is tied to renewal talks next month. Can we get a fast-track?

ron_support: Got it. Please paste the exact CIDRs, org id, routes impacted and preferred uplift factor. Also confirm auto-revoke time.

sprout_ops: Org: org_sprout_accel_5. CIDRs: 45.60.12.9/32 and 45.60.12.10/32. Routes: /v1/chat and /v1/embeddings. Uplift: 1.8x. Window: 2025-05-06T02:00:00Z -> 2025-05-06T03:30:00Z. Auto-revoke yes. Contact: ops@sprout.ai

kai_oncall: Plan: 1) region pin ap-southeast-1 for org_sprout_accel_5 with fallback allowed, 2) set per-route qps_override=1.8, 3) add ACL entries, 4) schedule revoke at 03:30Z. Tagging @arun_eng for IP sign-off.

arun_eng: quick review of IPs fine. Approve ACL and qps. Suggest limiting embeddings concurrency to 800 to avoid worker OOM on older instance types.

ron_support: Command I'll run in staging first:

```bash
redwoodctl orgs patch-policy --org org_sprout_accel_5 \\
  --patch '{"region_pin":"ap-southeast-1","routes":{"/v1/chat":{"qps_override":1.8},"/v1/embeddings":{"qps_override":1.8,"concurrency_cap":800}},"acls":["45.60.12.9/32","45.60.12.10/32"]}' \\
  --region ap-southeast-1 --expires 2025-05-06T03:30:00Z
```

ron_support: staging smoke passed, rolling to ap-southeast-1 now. Console: https://console.redwood.example/orgs/org_sprout_accel_5/policies

deploy-bot: action=policy.patch start_time=2025-05-05T20:12:02Z actor=ron_support status=queued

deploy-bot: action=policy.patch actor=ron_support status=success time=2025-05-05T20:14:08Z ref=patch-93412

kai_oncall: Verified policy live in ap-southeast-1. Auto-revoke scheduled. I'll watch p50/p95 latency and token usage during the window and post any anomalies.

sprout_ops: Warmup complete. Thanks team. If demo succeeds can we get follow-up on Dedicated pricing and SLA? We'll want guidance on long-term cost reductions.

ellen_csm: Noted  adding to renewal tracker and will schedule a deep-dive if demo looks good. Thanks for the quick turnaround :thumbsup:
